items.title: Meta-Heuristic-EKF-Track-Building
items.subtitle: Helical EKF + meta-heuristics for TrackML reconstruction
items.summary: Fast TrackML reconstruction built on a helical EKF core with A*, ACO, GA, PSO, SA, per-layer branching, vectorized kernels, robust gating, and built-in hyperparameter optimization.

items.title: mkbench
items.subtitle: Docker-first mkFit benchmarking harness
items.summary: A reproducible build, run, and comparison workflow for mkFit variants with TrackML geometry artifacts, scaling sweeps, plots, and machine-readable performance reports.

items.title: VaR-Backtesting-Toolkit
items.subtitle: Statistical validation for rolling risk models
items.summary: A command-line backtesting system for historical and Gaussian Value-at-Risk models using Kupiec and Christoffersen statistical tests with automated conditional-coverage reporting.
